## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.17

- **Google Drive sign-in built into Android**: connecting Google Drive now uses your phone's own Google account picker instead of the browser. It takes a couple of taps, and Settings show which account is connected. The app no longer carries a Google key or keeps a long-lived token. It needs Google Play services on the device.
- **Already connected?** The app keeps syncing. If Google needs you to confirm, you get a notification asking you to connect again from Settings › Data and storage.
- **Sync status in More**: a new "Sync" row tells you when the library was last synced, shows when a sync is running, and warns you if the last attempt failed or Google Drive needs to be connected again. Tap it to open the sync settings, or use its round button to sync right away. The sync settings also say why the last attempt failed.
- **Sync when you finish a chapter or an episode**: your other devices get your progress during a long session too, without waiting for you to leave the app. It runs quietly, at most every 10 minutes, and you can turn it off in "When to sync".
- **Update badge on the round buttons**: the gold badge now sits on the outer edge of the Anime and Manga buttons, so the Home button no longer covers part of it. On tablets it's a little bigger.
- **Long chapter and episode numbers on Home**: four-digit numbers (like chapter 1165) now show in full on the gold button of the "Continue reading" and "Continue watching" cards. Before, only "Ch." showed.
- **English and Italian everywhere**: the sync messages ("Sync complete" and the errors) are now in your language. Any text that isn't translated into your language yet shows in English.
- **Clearer Google Drive messages**: if access to Google Drive is removed, the app tells you to connect again instead of showing a technical error.
- **Release notes in English**: from this version on, the update notes are written in English.
